column1: # Campaign 27 exact original-test evidence for bounded prepared-statement binary framing.

column8: Hand-built packets prove exact signed MYSQL_TYPE_LONGLONG decoding and new-type versus reused-type vectors; TiDB's complete integer, temporal, decimal, string, bound-parameter, warning, NULL, unsigned, and coercion matrix remains open.

Every truncated field in the admitted fixed-width execute packet returns a typed error without slicing or fallback; length-encoded string parameters and their malformed/overflow corpus remain explicitly unsupported and open.

The bounded codec emits exact signed-BIGINT binary cells and rejects non-BIGINT parameter types; GBK decoding, bound string reuse, charset conversion, and the original string encode cases remain open.
A nonzero cursor flag is rejected as a typed protocol error before any statement or storage work; cursor creation, status flags, fetch lifecycle, COM_QUERY interaction, and row streaming remain open.

The admitted zero-cursor packet preserves one signed parameter and type reuse while every cursor packet fails closed; cursor resource accounting, RU reporting, parameterized fetch, and server lifecycle remain open.
